ayahs.translation: When the help of Allah and the victory come.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
ayahs.translation: And you see the people entering the religion of Allah in crowds.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
ayahs.translation: So glorify your Lord with praise and seek His forgiveness.
